subject: general
question: A man goes from his house to a vegetable market at the speed of 15 km/h and walked back at the speed of 10 km/h. If the whole journey took 2 hours 30 minutes, find the distance from his house to the vegetable market (in km),
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Time** (T) = 2.5 hours

**Distance** (D) = [ (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂) ] × Total Time

D = [ (15 × 10) ÷ (15 + 10) ] × 2.5

D = [ 150 ÷ 25 ] × 2.5 = 6 × 2.5 = 15 km

**∴ The correct answer is 15 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115d5beb1bb65ab833649edda94751863c03f3a39e30bcec2ab568b5bfaaeafb.png] 

**Given:**

Speed from **House** to **Market** (S₁) = 15 km/h

Speed from **Market** to **House** (S₂) = 10 km/h

Total Time taken = 2 hours 30 minutes = 2.5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Average Speed × (Total Time ÷ 2) OR Distance = (S₁ × S₂ × Total Time) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the distance be **D** km.

⇒ Time taken while going = D ÷ 15

⇒ Time taken while returning = D ÷ 10

⇒ Total Time = (D ÷ 15) + (D ÷ 10) = 2.5

⇒ (2D + 3D) ÷ 30 = 2.5

⇒ 5D ÷ 30 = 2.5

⇒ D ÷ 6 = 2.5

⇒ D = 6 × 2.5 = 15 km

**∴ The correct answer is 15 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

When the same distance is covered at two different speeds S₁ and S₂, the **Average Speed** = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Time Conversion

To convert minutes into hours, divide by 60. Example: 30 minutes = 30 ÷ 60 = 0.5 hours.

Ratio Method for Distance

If distance is constant, **Speed Ratio** is inversely proportional to **Time Ratio**. Speed Ratio 15:10 (3:2) → Time Ratio 2:3. Total 5 units = 150 min, so 2 units = 60 min (1 hr). Distance = 15 × 1 = 15 km.</p
